notes: The catalog service each inferred service name is, per carrier, so an inference
snapshots the same CarrierService row a direct purchase of that service would.
Keyed by the service names the other tables emit -- this ruleset's own vocabulary --
and naming CarrierService.service_code, which is a code and not a name: the catalog
calls USPS Ground Advantage 'Ground Advantage', and an operator may rename a row,
but the code is the seeder's key and does not move.
Carrier keys are matched through CarrierAlias::lookupKey against the canonical
A name absent here resolves to no catalog service, and the package still ships with
the inferred name as its service. Two are absent on purpose:
UPS Ground Saver -- the catalog splits it by weight (92 under 1 lb, 93 at 1 lb and
over), and neither the 1Z indicator YW nor the label says which side a parcel fell.
DHL SmartMail Parcel Ground -- DHL eCommerce has no catalog row.
